title: DEWALT DCC020IB 20V MAX Cordless Tire Inflator (Tool Only)
pros: 20V MAX platform is a published spec for buyers who already own DEWALT batteries
The manufacturer lists a 160 PSI maximum pressure for passenger-tire inflation tasks
Automatic shutoff and a 12V vehicle power option are published convenience features
Snapshot ranking on 2026-11-24: #3 in Air Tools, 4.6 stars across 18,752 reviews (reference only)
cons: Tool Only means no battery or charger is included, so total cost depends on what you already own
A 160 PSI maximum is a headline limit, not a measured inflation speed or duty cycle
Cordless convenience does not replace a jump starter; a dead battery still needs a separate tool
verdict: Editorial score reflects spec coverage, not Amazon star ratings. Based on published manufacturer and seller specifications, this is a cordless inflator aimed at drivers who already own a 20V MAX battery and want to avoid a gas-station air hose. The honest limit is the Tool Only listing: value depends on battery ownership, and a maximum PSI figure does not establish real-world fill time. No hands-on testing is claimed.
